title: Topic 3.5: Raising Lazarus from the Dead

pages.lesson:
LESSON: RAISING LAZARUS FROM THE DEAD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.5: Raising Lazarus from the Dead

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Raising Lazarus from the Dead. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Raising Lazarus from the Dead
2. Practise Raising Lazarus from the Dead at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Raising Lazarus from the Dead

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Raising Lazarus from the Dead
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Raising Lazarus from the Dead. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Raising Lazarus from the Dead at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Raising Lazarus from the Dead at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Raising Lazarus from the Dead
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Raising Lazarus from the Dead. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Raising Lazarus from the Dead using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Raising Lazarus from the Dead in the examples.
2. Explain Raising Lazarus from the Dead to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Raising Lazarus from the Dead.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Raising Lazarus from the Dead using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Raising Lazarus from the Dead important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Raising Lazarus from the Dead
2. Practise Raising Lazarus from the Dead at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Raising Lazarus from the Dead

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
